# ElizaOS Daily Digest: Aug 24, 2026

Development on August 24 focused on stabilizing group-chat scenarios and enhancing voice stream reliability, alongside critical system integrity updates to ensure UTF-16 surrogate pair safety across core services. The team also prioritized codebase health through extensive test coverage expansion and the removal of legacy assets.

## ✅ Completed Work

**Group-Chat and Scenario Stability**
*   Enabled resumable group-chat baselines and integrated a dedicated live evaluation lane into the CI pipeline to improve production readiness ([elizaos/eliza#27275](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/27275), [elizaos/eliza#27359](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/27359)).
*   Refined participation prompts and decision-only observation seams to reduce unsolicited group-chat responses ([elizaos/eliza#27933](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/27933), [elizaos/eliza#27508](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/27508)).

**Voice and Cloud Infrastructure**
*   Improved transport responsiveness by flushing cold voice stream readiness comments ([elizaos/eliza#27194](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/27194), [elizaos/eliza#26891](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/26891)).
*   Strengthened SDK authentication and media generation through robust error handling and credential rotation ([elizaos/eliza#27398](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/27398), [elizaos/eliza#27375](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/27375)).

**System Integrity and Codebase Cleanup**
*   Implemented `truncateWellFormed` across core services to prevent data corruption in X, Telegram, and Discord plugins ([elizaos/eliza#27967](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/27967), [elizaos/eliza#27966](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/27966), [elizaos/eliza#27948](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/27948)).
*   Maintained a lean codebase by deduplicating robot meshes and removing orphan files and stale lockfiles ([elizaos/eliza#27293](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/27293), [elizaos/eliza#27244](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/27244), [elizaos/eliza#27191](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/27191)).

## 🏗️ Work in Progress

**New Pull Requests (elizaos/eliza)**
*   [#28019](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/28019) - test(personal-assistant): cover localized examples resolver locale gating
*   [#28015](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/28015) - fix(plugin-todos): clear removes the user's whole cross-room list
*   [#27994](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/27994) - fix(companion): reject whitespace-only frame fields at the trust boundary
*   [#27992](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/27992) - fix(cloud): single settlement authority for MCP purchases
*   [#27982](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/27982) - fix(plugin-health): reject non-ISO timestamps in normalizeOptionalIsoString
